marks.title: Text, Logos, Shapes, And Signatures

fonts.title: 551 Unique Font Families
fonts.body: Search fonts by name and see each choice in its own typeface. Revisit recent fonts, adjust letter spacing and curve, and save the style in a watermark. Font files and their open-license notices are bundled with Lumafoil.

templates.body: Start with included presets such as Draft, Confidential, Do Not Copy, Proof, review stamps, or photo credits. Customize a preset and keep your version in Saved Watermarks. Organize saved watermarks into folders and reuse them in Images, Documents, Videos, or Bulk.

editing.title: Crop, Resize, And Adjust
editing.body: Crop or rotate a photo and adjust brightness, contrast, and saturation. Zoom in for placement, show an adjustable grid, and turn on snapping. Source resolution is retained unless you choose a crop or smaller output.

smart.title: Smart Placement And Contrast
smart.body: Let Lumafoil suggest a position and a light or dark mark based on the image. Review the result and move or restyle it yourself.

video.title: Video Placement And Fade Effects
video.body: Scrub the video beside inline watermark tools. Set positions at different timestamps, choose when each mark appears, and add fades. Exports are re-encoded; available formats and audio support depend on your browser and the source file.

pdf.title: Preview And Watermark PDF Pages
pdf.body: Read a PDF and position watermarks with tools beside the page. Apply them throughout the document or process multiple PDFs in Bulk. Watermarks are added to the original PDF pages, preserving their existing text, images, and vector artwork.

export.body: Export photos as PNG, JPEG, or WebP. PNG is the lossless default; JPEG and WebP use your chosen quality. Exports render from the original image, not the smaller editing preview.

gallery.title: Folders And Recent Work

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Lumafoil is built so your photographs stay yours. This page explains what happens to your images and your account information in plain language, drawn from the controls the project actually enforces.

photos.heading: Photos are processed on your device
photos.p1: Editing and watermarking run on your device. A preview does not upload your originals to Lumafoil.
photos.p2: You choose whether to download the output, save it to Watermarked Images, transfer it to connected cloud storage, or create a sharing link.

storage.heading: Accounts, saved work and offline copies
storage.p1: Cloudflare hosts account records, saved watermarks, gallery photos, thumbnails, uploaded logos, sharing records and recent-work history. Saved content belongs to its workspace; other users need explicit membership or a sharing link.
storage.p2: Account-scoped copies and queued edits are kept on this device for offline use. Reconnecting with the same account retries them. Pending edits block sign-out; completed sign-out clears the app’s offline data. Session expiry locks access without erasing pending work. Clearing browser data can erase unsynced edits.

metadata.heading: Personal metadata and artwork notices
metadata.p1: Image exports remove camera and location metadata by default. Supported options can retain camera fields without GPS, or retain supported original metadata. This processing happens in your browser.
metadata.p2: Exports using bundled artwork retain its license notice in metadata, a document attachment or an archive sidecar. Other software may remove these notices; retain the applicable notice when redistributing that artwork.

sharing.heading: Sharing links
sharing.p1: Anyone with a Lumafoil gallery link can view its selected saved photos until the link expires or is revoked. A site invitation creates access to a separate private account; it does not share the inviter’s workspace or content.
sharing.p2: Cloud providers’ own links follow their permissions and revocation rules. Revoking a link cannot recall downloads or copies already made.

account.heading: Your account
account.p1: New accounts require an invitation and a verified email. Sign in with a password or configured Google/Microsoft sign-in. Existing accounts need no new invitation. Adding another sign-in method requires authenticated account linking.
account.p2: Sessions use HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookies, marked Secure on HTTPS. Password-reset links expire after an hour and revoke other server sessions when used.

analytics.heading: Cookies and outside services
analytics.p1: Lumafoil includes no analytics beacon or advertising cookies. Essential cookies maintain sessions; device storage holds settings, offline copies and queued changes.
analytics.p2: When enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile checks account requests for bots; see its <turnstile>privacy notice</turnstile>. Google/Microsoft handle chosen sign-in. Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive receive requests through cloud features you choose; their own privacy policies apply.

audit.heading: Audit trail
audit.p1: Workspace audit logs require a workspace owner/admin role. The site owner and admins can manage accounts and review totals, moderation, audit entries and health/error records. Recent-work history is user-specific. Application failure logs omit tokens and request bodies.

reporting.heading: Reporting a problem
reporting.p1: For support, email <support>support@lumafoil.com</support>. Report vulnerabilities through <security>GitHub’s private reporting form</security> or that email address. Do not put tokens or personal content in public issues.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms cover your use of Lumafoil. They are written to be read, and they describe how the service actually behaves rather than adding claims it does not keep.

accepting.heading: Accepting these terms
accepting.p1: Using Lumafoil means you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

whatItDoes.heading: What the service does
whatItDoes.p1: Lumafoil adds watermarks to photos and supported documents and videos on your device. Accounts, saved galleries/watermarks, recent-work history, invitations and sharing use server storage; optional cloud features contact the chosen provider.
whatItDoes.p2: The source is free and open source under MIT. Bundled fonts and artwork have their own licenses.

account.heading: Your account
account.p1: Access is currently by invitation. A verified email is required; password and configured Google/Microsoft sign-in are available. Keep your credentials and provider account secure; you are responsible for use of your account.
account.p2: Sign-out needs a connection and resolved pending edits; it clears this browser’s offline app data. Password reset revokes other server sessions. Disconnected devices can retain local copies until they reconnect or their browser data is cleared.

content.heading: Your content
content.p1: You keep every right you already hold in the photos and watermarks you upload or create. You are responsible for having the right to use the images you bring to the service.
content.p2: Content is processed for the features you choose. Watermarked Images saves use Cloudflare; selected cloud transfers and sharing send content to providers or recipients. Lumafoil does not use it to train models. Bundled artwork has separate license-notice requirements.

acceptableUse.heading: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.p1: Do not use the service to break the law, or to upload or share content you have no right to use. Do not try to bypass security controls or rate limits, or to reach data belonging to workspaces you are not a member of.
acceptableUse.p2: Access within a workspace follows your role, and those roles are enforced on the server.

teams.heading: Private workspaces and collaboration
teams.p1: Each account starts with a private workspace. Site invitations do not share the inviter’s content. A workspace owner can explicitly grant View or Edit access to that workspace. This shares no other workspace and grants no site administration rights.

availability.heading: Availability, warranty, and changes
availability.p1: The service is provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind, as set out in the MIT license. Features may change, and the service may be unavailable at times.
availability.p2: These terms may be updated; the date at the top of this page shows when they last changed. Continuing to use the service after a change means you accept the updated terms.

openSource.heading: Open source
openSource.p1: Lumafoil’s source is MIT-licensed for inspection, use and modification under that license. Bundled fonts and artwork retain their own licenses and notices, linked in their pickers and the asset-license index.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.p1: Questions: <support>support@lumafoil.com</support>. Security reports: <security>GitHub’s private reporting form</security> or that email address. Keep sensitive details out of public issues.

images.body: Open a photo from your device, a link, or connected cloud storage. Zoom, grid and snapping help with placement. The original file stays untouched; editing and saved work remain available offline.

watermark.title: Create A Watermark
watermark.body: Add text, symbols, shapes, stickers, a logo, a signature or a QR code. Choose fonts and adjust placement, color, stroke, curve and style. Drag, pinch and rotate on the canvas; Undo reverses changes.

presets.title: Included Presets
presets.body: Presets contains the included designs, such as Draft and Confidential. Pick a starting point, then customize it in Watermark. These designs stay separate from your saved watermarks.

saved.title: Your Saved Designs
saved.body: Saved opens watermarks from this workspace. Save asks for a name; New starts another watermark while keeping the image. Reuse named QR codes, logos and text designs.

transform.title: Crop, Adjust And Resize
transform.body: Crop changes framing; Adjust controls photo appearance; Resize sets output dimensions. Each slider has a reset. Keep original dimensions unless you want a different size.

export.title: Save Your Image
export.body: Save Image opens the output controls. Download, share, save to Watermarked Images, or choose a cloud folder. PNG is the lossless default; other formats and quality settings are your choice.

documents.title: Documents
documents.body: Open a PDF, preview its pages and apply watermarks with the same inline tools. Export PDF saves the marked document while preserving its original page content.

videos.title: Videos
videos.body: Open a supported video and scrub the timeline. Place watermarks at different timestamps and add fades. Export Video uses those changes; output is re-encoded and format support depends on your browser.

bulk.title: Bulk
bulk.body: Process images, PDFs and videos together. Choose a watermark, review individual results, and download completed files in a ZIP. A failed file does not discard the other results.

library.title: Saved Watermarks
library.body: Organize your reusable designs into folders. Search, filter, switch views and find recent work here. Designs belong to the current workspace and sync when you reconnect.

gallery.title: Watermarked Images
gallery.body: Find recent saved images, organize folders and change views. Create and manage sharing links for selected images. Check A Photo looks for Lumafoil’s invisible mark.

account.title: Account And Cloud
account.body: Manage sign-in methods and connect Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive here. Connections persist until disconnected or revoked. Browse permitted folders when opening or saving files; provider consent rules still apply.

workspace.title: Workspaces And Access
workspace.body: Use the user menu to switch workspaces, invite people or Manage Access. Workspace owners grant View or Edit access. Personal invitation links admit new users without sharing your content. Sync status lives at the bottom of the sidebar.
